text_blocks.snippet: Tech Mahindra is a major global technology consulting and digital solutions company headquartered in Pune and Mumbai, India.
snippet_highlighted_words: a major global technology consulting and digital solutions company headquartered in Pune and Mumbai, India

list.snippet: Parent Company: Part of the Mahindra Group, which was founded in 1945.
Founded: Incorporated in 1986 as a joint venture with BT Group.
Leadership: Led by Managing Director and CEO Mohit Joshi.
Scale: Employs over 149,000 professionals across 90+ countries and serves more than 1,100 global clients.
IT & Digital Services: Offers application development, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software solutions.
Network & 5G Services: Specializes in next-generation network services and telecom solutions.
Artificial Intelligence: Focuses on generative AI, agentic workflows, and automation platforms like TechM Orion.
Engineering Services: Provides industrial design and R&D through subsidiaries like Pininfarina.
Stock Price: Trading around ₹1,534 per share (tracked via Tech Mahindra Ltd share price).
